ValidationRule.description: Standup time must sit on a 5-minute grid between 06:00 and 20:00, with no seconds/millis and no 12:00-12:29 slot.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Standup_Time__c)), OR( Standup_Time__c < TIMEVALUE('06:00:00.000'), Standup_Time__c >= TIMEVALUE('20:00:00.000'), MOD(MINUTE(Standup_Time__c), 5) <> 0, SECOND(Standup_Time__c) + MILLISECOND(Standup_Time__c) > 0, AND(HOUR(Standup_Time__c) = 12, MINUTE(Standup_Time__c) < 30) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Standup Time must be on a 5-minute grid between 06:00 and 20:00 (not during 12:00-12:29).
